Class PhasedProxyPlayer

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.server.proxies.PhasedProxyPlayer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Disconnectable, Heartbeatable, VirtualClient, VirtualGameClient, VirtualHallClient, VirtualRoomClient, VirtualGameServer, VirtualHallServer, VirtualRoomServer, VirtualServer, Serializable, Remote
Direct Known Subclasses:
RmiProxyPlayer, SocketProxyPlayer
public abstract class PhasedProxyPlayer extends Object implements VirtualClient, VirtualServer, Heartbeatable, Serializable
The PhasedProxyPlayer abstract class acts as a server-side representative (Proxy) for a connected client. It abstracts the underlying network technology (Socket or RMI) and handles the player's session, including heartbeats, timeouts, and application phases (e.g., HALL, ROOM, GAME). It implements Serializable to allow the server to save the player's logical state, marking network-specific or volatile fields as transient.

  • Constructor Details

    • PhasedProxyPlayer

      public PhasedProxyPlayer(ServerMultiplexer server, String nickname, ApplicationPhase startingPhase, VirtualServerAdapter serverSide, VirtualClient clientSide, ObjectInputStream input, ObjectOutputStream output)
      Constructs a new base proxy for a player.
      Parameters:
      server - the main server multiplexer managing this connection.
      nickname - the unique nickname of the player.
      startingPhase - the initial phase the player is put into (usually HALL).
      serverSide - the adapter linking the proxy to the current server logic.
      clientSide - the RMI client stub (null if using Socket).
      input - the Socket input stream (null if using RMI).
      output - the Socket output stream (null if using RMI).

    • assureRightPhase

      protected boolean assureRightPhase(Datapacket datapacket)
      Verifies if an incoming packet matches the current application phase of the player. Prevents out-of-context commands (e.g., trying to play a card while in the Hall).

      Returns:
      true if the packet is valid for the current phase or is phase-agnostic (ANY).

    • disconnectProcedure

      protected void disconnectProcedure(DisconnectPacket disconnectPacket) throws Exception
      Executes the actual logic to tear down the player's connection. Stops the heartbeat scheduler, alerts the game controller (if in-game) to suspend the player, and detaches from the server-side environment.
      Parameters:
      disconnectPacket - the packet containing disconnection details.
      Throws:
      Exception - if an error occurs while notifying the server or controller.

    • reconnect

      public void reconnect(VirtualClient newClientSide, ObjectInputStream newInput, ObjectOutputStream newOutput) throws Exception
      Restores the player's session using new network streams/stubs after a temporary drop. It reconnects the controller, syncs the phase, and notifies the game that the player is back.
      Parameters:
      newClientSide - the new RMI client stub (null if using Socket).
      newInput - the new Socket input stream (null if using RMI).
      newOutput - the new Socket output stream (null if using RMI).
      Throws:
      Exception - if the reconnection or state synchronization fails.

    • resumeAfterServerCrash

      public void resumeAfterServerCrash(ServerMultiplexer server)
      Re-initializes transient fields after the server has recovered its state from disk. Ensures the proxy is in a clean, disconnected state waiting for the actual client to reconnect.
      Parameters:
      server - the newly booted ServerMultiplexer to attach to.
